title: Not worth it, didn't get what I was expecting.
text: Cute presentation, which is why I'm giving 2 stars instead of one.  Disappointed when I ordered a "mostly sour" box, and only 3 of 6 containers were sour candy.  Mostly, by definition - is more than half.  I got this box for half off and still feel I can get a better deal buying candy at a grocery or candy store.
label: negative
